## Terms

### index

- **index** · self — - Index names must be unique. Creating an index with the name of an existing index returns an error. - You can't rename an existing index. Instead, you must [drop](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/drop-index/#std-label-drop-an-index) and recreate the index with a new name. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing, indexed — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/create-index/specify-index-name/#about-this-task

- **index build** · dependent — [Index Builds on Populated Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/) for more information on the behavior of indexing operations in MongoDB. · aka: index builds, CREATE INDEX, createIndex, createIndexes, DROP INDEX, dropIndex, dropIndexes, CONCURRENTLY, index creation, create an index, add an index, drop an index, rolling index build, staged index, getIndexes, listIndexes, index backfill — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/reIndex/#tip
